gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Weighty and a little theatrical, Metamorphous spaces its soft-contrast curves generously above Noto Sans Myanmar's dense, dark band of text. One loves a grand entrance; the other just gets on with it.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-nabatae: Noto Sans Nabataean stands its lowercase almost as tall as the capitals, with wide, open s curves, beneath a Metamorphous heading of generous sidebearings. Down a long page, it moves briskly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-nag-mun: Noto Sans Nag Mundari shapes its c and s as if half unwrapped, with lowercase that rivals the capitals. And Metamorphous, stems barely heavier than its joining strokes, makes the strongest quality here a gentle, commanding restraint.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu reads tall and airy, its terminals held far from the stroke body and its x-height towering under a Metamorphous heading. Its strongest quality is that lofty, modern openness.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Stately yet approachable, Metamorphous shows a mild, friendly stroke contrast above Noto Sans Ogham, whose tall bodies make the lowercase look bold. But the heading excels at presence, while the body excels at crisp clarity.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-ol-chik: Metamorphous leads with a high midline and crossbars a bit finer than its main stems, over Noto Sans Ol Chiki. And its curve tails stay pulled back, so words settle into solid blocks beneath the heading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-old-hun: Wide sidebearings and a high-set midline give Metamorphous its commanding, distinctive look, with medium stroke contrast. Noto Sans Old Hungarian follows with large open counters, apertures that hold open even at tiny sizes, and an approachable feel.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-old-ita: Noto Sans Old Italic reads tightly, with almost no gap between x-height and cap height and curve endings kept well apart. Metamorphous brings a soft contrast that never looks flat or stark; that softness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-old-nor: Metamorphous carries a commanding, high-midline look. Noto Sans Old North Arabian settles into a dense, tall lowercase band whose terminals point outward like tongs, which makes a long passage feel packed but approachable.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-old-per: Noto Sans Old Permic keeps its rounded forms clearly open to the side, with lowercase nearly matching capitals in height. And Metamorphous, thinning slightly at the sides of its bowls, leads into a long passage that reads approachably.
